paper.title: DPO hyperparameters (Appendix B) on the synthetic controlled-generation task

note: Paper defaults: beta 0.1 (0.5 for TL;DR), batch 64, RMSprop lr 1e-6 with linear warmup over 150 steps. Paper experiments use GPT-2-large on IMDb with a sentiment classifier reward, GPT-J on Reddit TL;DR, and Pythia-2.8B on Anthropic HH, evaluated by GPT-4 win rates; these require Hugging Face models/datasets not bundled here. With a tiny model lr 1e-6 is very slow; sweep lr for the synthetic task.
